title: Let's Explore 8 Creations Made with GPT Astra

scenes.title: 이런 것도 만들었네요
lines: From a knight's campsite to a train in the sky, let's explore eight creations their makers say they built with Astra.

scenes.title: 모닥불 옆 기사의 하루
lines: First up is a little campsite where a knight spends his day beside a fire.
He adds firewood, practices with his sword, and cooks some meat. When he's tired, he lies down to sleep.
It's not just about fighting. This knight gets some downtime, too.

scenes.title: 하늘을 달리는 기차
lines: Next is a train game set high in the sky.
Travel between floating islands and pick up passengers at the station. You can customize your train in the garage, too.
I'm supposed to drive the train, but I'd rather enjoy the view first.

scenes.title: 내 방을 꾸미고 낚시까지
lines: This creation is a virtual world where you can decorate your own room and explore.
Place a desk and chair, change their colors, then step inside. Head outdoors and you can even go fishing.
I came to decorate a room and ended up catching fish.

scenes.title: 한 사람이 만든 네 가지 작품
lines: This post brings together four creations by one maker.
There's a canal town full of moving residents, and a game where you guide a ring without touching a wire.
There's a chase game where you run from a chef, and a downhill game with a vehicle you assemble yourself.
From a quiet stroll through town to narrowly dodging obstacles, each one has a different feel.

scenes.title: 캐릭터를 더 예쁘게 다듬기
lines: This one is about refining the look of a little character.
The creator works on the colors of the clothes and hair, turning the model around to inspect awkward spots.
There's still work to do, but you can see the character coming together.

scenes.title: 만화 같은 캐릭터 표현
lines: Here, the creator worked on colors and shadows with a Zenless Zone Zero-inspired look.
This isn't about creating the character itself from scratch, but about how it appears in a game.
The close-ups of the face and outfit show off those comic-like colors.

scenes.title: 다른 게임의 그림체도
lines: The same creator also shared a character rendering inspired by Endfield.
The demo shows the colors and shadows of the hair and clothing, turning the character to view it from different angles.
The colors can give a 3D character a very different feel.

scenes.title: 차를 타고 돌아다니는 도시
lines: Finally, here's a city you can drive around.
The demo shows driving along the coast, walking through the streets, and firing a gun.
With buildings, cars, and people all together, it feels like visiting a neighborhood in a game rather than a single small scene.
It makes me wonder what's around the next corner.

scenes.title: 어떤 작품이 가장 끌리나요?
lines: From a little campsite to an entire city, there's quite a range. Which one would you like to try? Let me know in the comments.
